about_the_game:
This Bundle Contains:


  • Chaos Undivided 2D style (for Soviet vehicles only)
  • Unique crew member Fecrustus Spute with Brothers in Arms as zero perk and enough XP for two extra perks (for Soviet vehicles only)
  • x6 Seal of Chaos Decal (for Soviet vehicles only)

NOTE: This DLC is only available until October 7, 2024.

Bundle Description:


Succumb to the Chaos Gods and enjoy the contents of this lurid bundle: a Chaos Undivided 2D style, six Seal of Chaos Decals and a unique crew member Fecrustus Spute. Show your enemies that they stand no chance against the Ruinous Powers of Chaos!

Fecrustus Spute. Although he views himself as one of Nurgle's favorites, some might say he thinks too highly of himself. He will use any means, even brute force, to prove his loyalty to his patron God, so long as he believes that it will help him win favor. His ambition and fanatical desire to gain approval could be considered negative qualities, but they've paid off so far.

This unique crew member is only suitable for Soviet vehicles. You can choose his specialization. Fecrustus Spute has the Brothers in Arms perk trained to 100%, along with enough Crew XP to train two additional perks.

DLC can be added to your World of Tanks account only once.
You will be able to use this DLC only if you play from the game account created on Steam.
